name: Random Game Picker
summary: Pick a random game from the existing EmulationStation library with filters and scraped artwork.

notes: Owner-authorized first experimental device test. Neither handheld, physical controller mapping nor the ES launch handoff is verified. Desktop fixtures are not hardware evidence.

The picker reads effective ES system configuration, gamelists and the live ES catalogue; no game ROM directory or emulator command is hardcoded. Ports, collections, missing/hidden games and ambiguous launch paths are excluded.

The only network use is bounded HTTP to 127.0.0.1:1234. Play closes SDL, sends one exact raw-path POST to ES and exits. HTTP acceptance does not confirm play; there is no retry or nested configgen fallback.

The Store owns only its package directory and one Ports menu entry. Runtime settings and the per-session log remain under state and survive repair, update and uninstall. A nonstandard configured Ports root needs manual installation in that root instead.

AArch64 ELF inspection establishes a glibc 2.36 minimum. System SDL2, SDL2_image and SDL2_ttf are required. No firmware library is replaced. Persistent indexing, Surprise Mode and device performance evidence are not included.

evidence.note: Version-pinned asset 655107287: 1,088,216 compressed bytes, 2,818,747 regular-file bytes; SHA-256 b37fbfcea1d38345f26a9a65995a5fc2bfbe8ae3f2267265bad947c694f66607. Exact size and digest reject replacement bytes even if GitHub permits release asset replacement.
MIT project license; archive includes notices for the font, static pugixml, JSON headers and libstdc++ runtime exception. SDL libraries remain system dependencies.

ELF64 AArch64, interpreter /lib/ld-linux-aarch64.so.1; highest GLIBC symbol 2.36. NEEDED: libSDL2_image-2.0.so.0, libSDL2_ttf-2.0.so.0, libSDL2-2.0.so.0, libm.so.6, libc.so.6, ld-linux-aarch64.so.1. libstdc++, libgcc and pugixml are static.

Launcher sets package-local state; source has no shell command construction, download or self-update. Settings JSON and last-run.log are the runtime writes. ES config, ROMs, art and saves are read-only to the picker; the launched emulator can make its normal writes.

Host contracts, real SDL fixture at 1280x720 and 640x480, 100 rerolls per size, filters, PNG/JPEG preview, corrupt-art fallback, empty recent pool/reset, window teardown before exactly one fake-ES raw-path POST; cross-package ABI gate. This is not a handheld or emulator launch test.

install.warning: Experimental: no handheld launch is verified. Requires glibc 2.36+, SDL2/image/ttf and the local ES API. Submit Play once; inspect state/last-run.log after a failure before retrying. Standard Ports location only. Settings/logs stay after uninstall.
